reason: `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled` requires `user != null` (UsernamePasswordForm.java:160-161), so on a first login with no user the guards at :115 and :137 skip `fillContextForm`. Before the patch it ran only when the user was null. Without that call, nothing sets `ENABLE_WEBAUTHN_CONDITIONAL_UI` (WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator.java:43) or `AUTH_CHALLENGE_NOTE` (WebAuthnAuthenticator.java:90), which the passkey action later reads at WebAuthnAuthenticator.java:176, so passkey login on the start page breaks.
